preimage: absent: /opt/data/plugins/brain does not exist before the first install

runtime_config.activation: memory.provider: brain in /opt/data/config.yaml (host /srv/hermes-example/config.yaml); not in plugins.enabled
runtime_config.optional_settings: /opt/data/brain.json: {"prefetch", "preferences", "idle_marker": "on" | "off"}; no file, or a setting left out, means on
runtime_config.prefetch_log: /opt/data/brain-prefetch.log (host /srv/hermes-example/brain-prefetch.log): one JSON line per failed or skipped read; created 0600, O_APPEND; appears with the first failure
runtime_config.outbox: /opt/data/brain-outbox.jsonl (host /srv/hermes-example/brain-outbox.jsonl): one JSON line per marker a transport error kept from the hub; created 0600, O_APPEND; sent again after the next read that works; exists only while something waits
runtime_config.token_file_requirement: the existing hermes-wa GT bearer file; absolute regular file; runtime-owned; parent 0700; file 0600; no new secret

requires: a hub release with memory.list kind=preference first (memory follow-ons P1); an older hub refuses the preference read as invalid arguments, and every block is then the not-reachable line until the hub is updated or preferences is set off
